Build passes.

## Summary

Changes to `frontend/src/pages/ResultsPage.jsx`:

- **L14-27** (new): added `LEGACY_NO_TEXT_DETAIL_MARKER` constant and `isLegacyNoTextResponse(res)` helper that detects the backend's 422 detail `"Document has no extractable text. Upload the document first."` from `POST /api/deadline/analyze/{document_id}` (found in `backend/src/api/routers/deadline.py:169-173`).
- **In `loadDeadlines`** (~L75-85): on a failed `analyze` POST, checks `isLegacyNoTextResponse(res)` first; if true, sets `dlState('legacy-no-text')` and returns early instead of falling into the generic error path.
- **In `DeadlinesView`** (~L305-317, new branch before the generic `error` case): renders a plain-language panel — "We can't find deadlines for this document" / "This document was uploaded before we stored the full text. Upload the document again to get deadlines." — with an "Upload again" button using the existing `<Link to="/upload">` pattern already used elsewhere in the file (matches the sidebar/error-state upload links).

The diff is additive only (one new helper, one new `if` branch in the POST error path, one new render branch) — no existing logic, JSX structure, or the API client was touched.

`npm run build` succeeds (`vite build` completes, only a pre-existing chunk-size warning unrelated to this change).
